actionsOnce.script: const editor=window.editor; if(!editor) return {ok:false,error:'editor_missing'}; const state=editor.difficultyAuthoring && editor.difficultyAuthoring.state; if(!state) return {ok:false,error:'difficulty_state_missing'}; state.mode='custom'; state.selectedLevels=[]; state.lastCustomSelectedLevels=[]; editor.applyDifficultyAuthoringStateToTaskData(); editor.renderDifficultyAuthoringControls(); editor.updateSaveStatus(); const container=document.getElementById('editor-difficulty-authoring'); return {ok:true, blocking:container ? container.dataset.blocking : null};
